title: Project Portfolio Tracker
subtitle: Build a live-looking RAG portfolio dashboard that tells leadership exactly where to focus.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: 4 sheets: Portfolio Scorecard (10 KPIs), Project Details (10 projects, RAG, budget %, milestones), Revenue at Risk ($8.2M across 4 projects), Escalation Cards (P003 Foxconn + P010 Panasonic detail)
1-page escalation thresholds (Green/Amber/Red criteria), owner contacts, review cadence
Genpact brand logo — attach so the AI embeds it in the tracker header
Design system: slate #0F172A accent, RAG color coding Green/Amber/Red, card patterns — attach so the AI matches this visual standard
Target tracker layout: 5-tile portfolio summary, escalation cards for Red projects, project table with RAG filter — attach so the AI matches this layout

learning_objectives: Frame the escalation story before writing any prompt — decide which projects need VP action today and what those decisions are
Write your own AI prompt using a 5-area scaffold: audience, data, design, what to build, output rules
Test your first output against the data file — verify at least 3 figures before you iterate
Improve with one targeted follow-up instead of re-prompting from scratch
Make escalation-first design decisions — which projects lead the narrative, what the VP must decide before leaving the room, and how to make a Red status impossible to defer
deliverable: Single-file interactive HTML project portfolio dashboard
